title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Emmanuel College rituals marking the student journey, from a first class portrait and service day through annual academic, spiritual, and seasonal gatherings.

cards.title: Step Into the Official Class Photo
cards.subtitle: A move-in-weekend tradition with a class banner
cards.notes: Watch for Welcome Week instructions, then join your cohort at the announced campus location for the formal portrait and banner procession.
cards.short_summary: New students enter Emmanuel’s visual record together, creating a cohort portrait near the beginning of their college journey.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel calls the formal class photo one of its oldest traditions; the documented Class of 2025 event also included an official class banner and procession.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2021 event was limited to the Class of 2025; future cohorts should follow their own Welcome Week schedule.

cards.title: Open the Year at Academic Convocation
cards.subtitle: First-years are formally welcomed as seniors don regalia
cards.notes: Attend with your class and listen for the speakers who connect the new academic year to Emmanuel’s founding values and shared purpose.
cards.short_summary: A formal gathering places incoming students and graduating seniors at opposite ends of the Emmanuel academic journey.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel celebrates Academic Convocation at the start of every academic year, recognizing first-year students as new community members and seniors as they first don caps and gowns.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled by the College at the beginning of the academic year; consult the current campus calendar for attendance details.

cards.title: Receive the Emmanuel Seal Pin
cards.subtitle: Sophomores mark the declaration of their major
cards.notes: Register by the announced deadline, invite permitted guests, and meet the faculty member who will present your Emmanuel College seal pin.
cards.short_summary: The sophomore class turns choosing a major into a formal milestone recognized by faculty and families.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel describes Sophomore Pinning as a yearly class tradition where faculty present sophomores with an Emmanuel College seal pin to recognize selection of a major.
cards.access_notes: For eligible sophomores and registered guests; the 2026 ceremony permitted each student four guests in the gymnasium.

cards.title: Cross Junior Twilight
cards.subtitle: A spring career panel marks the rise to senior year
cards.notes: Join the junior-class panel, bring a career question, and stay for the concluding gathering that recognizes the transition into senior year.
cards.short_summary: Emmanuel gives the in-between stage of college its own name and pairs the moment with practical career preparation.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel documents Junior Twilight as an annual spring tradition featuring a junior-class career panel followed by food and music to mark the class’s rise to senior year.
cards.access_notes: Intended for the junior class; current scheduling and entry details are announced by Emmanuel.

cards.title: Eat Breakfast at the End of the Day
cards.subtitle: A finals-season evening in the Jean Yawkey Center
cards.notes: Check the semester calendar, arrive for the early activities, and follow the event into Marian Hall when the late-evening breakfast service begins.
cards.short_summary: Finals preparation pauses for an evening sequence of activities followed by breakfast foods in the dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel’s 2026 event page calls Moonlight Breakfast an annual end-of-semester tradition, with activities in the Jean Yawkey Center followed by breakfast in the dining hall.
cards.access_notes: A campus student event; the cited 2026 edition ran from 7:00–11:00 p.m. Current dates and eligibility may differ.

cards.title: Gather for the Annual Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: A December observance on Emmanuel’s mission calendar
cards.notes: Confirm the December date through Mission & Ministry, then arrive before the announced lighting time to gather with the campus community.
cards.short_summary: Emmanuel’s seasonal calendar centers a recurring community gathering around the lighting of its Christmas tree.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel’s Traditions & Events page identifies the Christmas tree lighting as annual, while Mission & Ministry listed the 2025 lighting for December 4 at 5:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The cited calendar date was for 2025; check the current Mission & Ministry calendar before attending.

cards.title: Trace Two Foundings in One Week
cards.subtitle: Emmanuel’s 1919 origin meets the Sisters’ 1804 story
cards.notes: Choose a liturgy, lecture, or reflection activity and use it to connect Emmanuel’s founding with the mission of St. Julie Billiart.
cards.short_summary: The College devotes a full week to the linked histories of Emmanuel and the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel documents Founders’ Week as an annual celebration honoring both the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur’s 1804 founding and their founding of Emmanuel in 1919.
cards.access_notes: The week includes multiple community events; consult the current program because individual activities may have separate arrangements.

cards.title: Begin the Academic Year With an Invocation
cards.subtitle: The College pairs this Mass with Convocation
cards.notes: Check the opening-week schedule and attend respectfully as the community invokes guidance and wisdom for the coming academic year.
cards.short_summary: A centuries-old Catholic practice becomes Emmanuel’s spiritual counterpart to the formal academic opening.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel celebrates the Mass of the Holy Spirit with Academic Convocation as the official start of its academic year, invoking guidance and wisdom.
cards.source_title: Mass of the Holy Spirit | Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: A Catholic liturgy for the College community; current time and location should be confirmed through Mission & Ministry.

cards.title: Start College by Serving Boston
cards.subtitle: New Saints volunteer before classes formally begin
cards.notes: Follow orientation placement details, dress for the assigned task, and work alongside classmates at the designated Boston-area nonprofit.
cards.short_summary: Emmanuel’s newest class meets one another through organized work at food programs, shelters, farms, and public spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel reports that its New Student Day of Service was a tradition for more than 20 years before a pandemic hiatus and resumed in 2025 with over 360 students volunteering.
cards.source_title: Class of ’29 Connects with Community Through the New Student Day of Service | Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Organized for new students through orientation; assignments may involve off-campus travel and task-specific clothing or mobility needs.

cards.title: Process Into Baccalaureate in Academic Dress
cards.subtitle: Graduates gather for Mass one day before Commencement
cards.notes: Bring your gown and hood, arrive at the time issued to graduates, and join the faculty procession and thanksgiving for the graduating class.
cards.short_summary: On Commencement eve, academic regalia enters a liturgy dedicated to learning, gratitude, and the graduating class.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel describes Baccalaureate as a longstanding tradition held the day before Commencement; graduates attend in gowns and hoods while faculty process in full academic attire.
cards.access_notes: All students and guests were invited regardless of religious affiliation in 2026; graduates were instructed to wear gowns and hoods.
